note: Community tags that describe how a card was designed, printed, errata'd, named or templated, not what it does. Hand-written 2026-10-14 from the 353 tags that form a group of 5 or more among the 1,300 cards with no readable ability, plus a scan of all 1,131 surviving tags for the same kinds of word. Applied by src/tag_layer_filter.py on top of the existing filter (oracle type, floor of 20 taggings, the card_function_search denylist). Matched by slug (tag UUIDs are the key in the layer; the slug is resolved to the UUID at build time, so a renamed tag is caught by the UUID list in build/tag_layer_filter.json). Added after the 2026-10-14 placement check: the prefix type-addition- (errata that added a type to a card) was missed in the first pass and surfaced as one wrong placement.

errata.reason: the tag records a type-line, keyword or token errata, not an effect

name_or_flavor_trivia.reason: the tag is about the card's name, franchise, art or collector status

templating_or_rules_jargon.reason: the tag is about how the text is written or ruled, not what the card does

set_design_or_generic.reason: the tag is a set-design pattern or a vague quality label (a drawback, catching up), not a described effect
